reviewed_by: Delegated coding agent static review against live Binary Ninja 6.0.10601 MCP (retail PE view_1), radare2 6.2.0 CFG and angr 10.0.4.post1 CFGFast on retail igi.exe; candidate source read from this worktree. No game process was executed and no runtime behavior is claimed.
review_basis: Retail 0x004AF764 was re-disassembled, re-decompiled and re-CFG'd through the live Binary Ninja view, independently recovered with radare2 6.2.0 and angr 10.0.4.post1 CFGFast. The candidate is scripts/GameNatives/camera/004AF764-Camera_UpdateTransform_31.cpp at sha256 1e420ba8d7cfc505902f28926001409f69cd886f2dfd0e580a29013f0a87d1aa (recorded implementation.signature: uint32_t __stdcall Camera_UpdateTransform_31(struct param_1);). The evidence artifact digests are bound in this review.

retail_function.name: Camera_UpdateTransform_31
retail_function.summary: Six-byte import thunk 0x004AF764: `jmp dword [0x533020]` to AVIFileRelease; one block, no edges, no locals, no numeric constants.

candidate_function.summary: The candidate file defines `AVIFileRelease` with AVIFileRelease's own prototype and the body `return AVIFileRelease();`, i.e. a self-recursive call to itself.

divergences: Candidate defines AVIFileRelease itself and tail-calls AVIFileRelease, turning the retail IAT thunk (jmp dword [0x533020]) into an infinite self-call.
The record's declared function Camera_UpdateTransform_31 is never defined in the candidate; only the import name is defined.
candidate_comparison.statement: Divergences are listed above; by contract they keep the record at TRANSCRIBED or lower.

checks.name: function_identity
checks.detail: Retail entry 0x004AF764 is recovered by all three tools; the address-bound implementation is scripts/GameNatives/camera/004AF764-Camera_UpdateTransform_31.cpp (sha256 1e420ba8d7cfc505902f28926001409f69cd886f2dfd0e580a29013f0a87d1aa). Six-byte import thunk 0x004AF764: `jmp dword [0x533020]` to AVIFileRelease; one block, no edges, no locals, no numeric constants. Candidate: The candidate file defines `AVIFileRelease` with AVIFileRelease's own prototype and the body `return AVIFileRelease();`, i.e. a self-recursive call to itself.

checks.name: abi_and_signature
checks.detail: Binary Ninja models 0x004AF764 with the imported routine's prototype (AVIFileRelease); the candidate's record signature is Camera_UpdateTransform_31's prototype but the file defines `AVIFileRelease` with the import's prototype, so the declared record function is not the function the file defines.

checks.name: argument_mapping
checks.detail: Retail forwards the caller's frame unchanged through the IAT slot 0x533020; the candidate's `AVIFileRelease()` takes the import's parameter list and passes it to itself.

checks.name: control_flow_shape
checks.detail: Binary Ninja and radare2 agree on 1 blocks / 0 edges (similarity 1.000); angr CFGFast recovers 1 blocks with has_unresolved_jumps=false.

checks.name: calls_and_side_effects
checks.detail: Retail has exactly one indirect jump to the IAT entry 0x533020 (AVIFileRelease); the candidate calls AVIFileRelease, which it itself defines, so the call never reaches the import.

checks.name: constants_and_scaling
checks.detail: Single relocatable constant: the IAT slot 0x533020.

checks.name: memory_layout_and_access
checks.detail: No stack locals and no global writes; the only memory access is the IAT pointer load performed by the jmp.

checks.name: return_and_error_paths
checks.detail: Retail returns AVIFileRelease's EAX/EDX unchanged because the jmp forwards the callee's return; the candidate never reaches the real body and cannot return its value.

signature_comparison.rationale: Binary Ninja reports "uint32_t __stdcall(struct IAVIFile pfile)" at 0x004AF764; radare2 recovers "ulong sub.AVIFIL32.dll_AVIFileRelease ();". Both tools place the entry at 0x004AF764 and agree on the stack/register word count and cleanup; the difference is the level of type/argument-name detail, not the call frame. Candidate declaration: uint32_t __stdcall Camera_UpdateTransform_31(struct param_1);. The candidate declaration is separately recorded as divergent below and does not satisfy the retail ABI.

limitations: No game process was executed; this review is static (live Binary Ninja, radare2 CFG, angr CFGFast) plus the candidate source.
The catalog name Camera_UpdateTransform_31 is a harvest label for the import thunk at 0x004AF764; the real retail identity is the IAT forwarder to AVIFileRelease.
